method.propertyTranscription: Literal message text with surrounding whitespace removed. Decorative images, memory addresses, controls and generic section titles omitted.

independentVerification.method: Strict pyHanko parsing, complete PDF manifest hashes, base-prefix structural checks (no base hashes supplied), OpenSSL cms -verify -binary -noverify (chain trust excluded).

baseObjectComparison.description: All bytes before the original base xref match round-3 S1, apart from the declared header substitution. T8 removes one header byte; its in-use xref offsets resolve correctly.

interpretation.observed: T3 and T5 VALID with subsequent changes. T1, T2, T4, T6, T7 and T8 INVALID, altered or corrupted. All identities trusted.
interpretation.smallestSuccessfulTestedCombination: Dense base xref with explicit free entries plus base trailer Info (T5). The individual components S1 and S3 failed in round 3; the original base with the same signing/append recipe failed as I2 in round 2.
interpretation.headerAndId: T5 retains the 4-byte first ID and original CRLF header, so neither change is necessary for this successful construction. Both dense+LF variants T1 and T8 fail.
interpretation.notUniversal: Round-3 S5, a broader qpdf rewrite, succeeds without base-trailer Info. The result identifies a sufficient combination for this ebook and workflow, not a universal requirement or Acrobat internal algorithm.
interpretation.signingRevisionCaveat: Where base-trailer Info is absent, the signing revision uses a newly allocated Info object 1244 0 R. Where present, it retains Info 977 0 R. Therefore the base-trailer change also changes signing-writer behavior; this batch does not isolate a pure base-parser rule.
interpretation.categoryCaution: The five Annotations Modified rows are literal Acrobat UI output. The final revision has only a new unreferenced object, with no existing-object rewrite or effective trailer-value change apart from Size and Prev. These rows do not demonstrate actual post-signature annotation edits.
limitations: Only the supplied pyHanko-signed, orphan-appended files were tested in this round.
No standalone signed-only controls were supplied or opened in this round.
No base_sha256 values were supplied in the round-4 manifest; full-file hashes were verified, and base-prefix hashes computed for reference.
T5 does not establish a fix for every malformed PDF, signing writer or subsequent-edit type.
interpretation.suggestedNextConfirmation: Preserve T5 as a frozen case. Before changing the sample ebook, confirm its base construction with both signing writers and representative later edits such as field filling and commenting, alongside signed-only controls.
